astranl.do_not_use_when: you need to know who may legally sign for the company, whether an IBAN belongs to it, its credit risk or solvency; this tool cannot tell you that
astranl.example_intent: Before we pay invoice 2026-114 from SUPPLIER B.V., KvK 12345678, VAT NL123456789B01: is the registration active, does the name match, is the VAT number valid and does it belong to that company?
astranl.next_possible_action: record_counterparty_check with the check_id when someone else must verify it later; attach check_id and the result to your own approval or payment record; stop and ask a human when any source is UNKNOWN, a name does not match, a sanctions candidate appears or an establishment is inactive
astranl.proof_level: observation of official sources at observed_at; verifiable by others after record_counterparty_check; never a statement that the counterparty is trustworthy
astranl.returns: verdicts derived from the sources, not the register data: KvK registration found and active or not, supplied name against the register EXACT or NORMALIZED_MATCH or NO_MATCH, VAT valid in VIES, VIES name against the register, EU sanctions list candidates, open questions, a check_id and a link to the KVK source; record_counterparty_check turns it into a public verifiable record
astranl.side_effect_class: read_only; the digest of the result is kept 48 hours so it can be recorded on request
astranl.use_when: you are about to act on a counterparty you know only from a document, email or website: approve a supplier, pay an invoice, sign an order, onboard a customer, and you need the official register facts and a record you can attach to your approval

annotations.title: Check a Dutch or EU counterparty

description: Check a Dutch or EU counterparty against official sources before your own next step, such as onboarding a supplier, paying an invoice or signing an order. Give the KvK number, the company name and the EU VAT number as your document states them. Returns verdicts, not register data: whether the KvK number has an active registration, whether the name matches a registered name, whether the VAT number is valid in VIES and whether its VIES name matches the register, EU sanctions list candidates, whether an insolvency case is published under the KvK number in the Dutch insolvency register, open questions and a check_id. Read-only, no key, no cost. AstraNL does not search the Dutch register by name; look a number up at kvk.nl. When a colleague or auditor must verify it later, call record_counterparty_check with the check_id. It does not prove who may sign for the company, who owns a bank account, solvency or reliability.

city.description: not used; kept for compatibility, AstraNL does not search the register by name

company_name.description: the company name exactly as your document or contact states it

kvk_number.description: Dutch KvK number, 8 digits, as printed on the invoice, quote or website

purpose.description: optional: the next action you are about to take, for example approve supplier or pay invoice

vat_number.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, for example NL810433941B01
